2607.00147.title: RareDxR1: Autonomous Medical Reasoning for Rare Disease Diagnosis Beyond Human Annotation
2607.00147.paper_summary: Rare disease differential diagnosis is a critical yet arduous clinical task, requiring physicians to identify precise phenotypes from complex, unstructured patient symptoms and execute intricate reasoning within a vast search space. However, existing AI approaches typically rely on pipeline-based phenotype extraction or retrieval-augmented generation, which suffer from critical information loss due to predefined ontologies, retrieval bottlenecks, and a lack of diagnostic logic. To address these challenges, we introduce RareDxR1, an end-to-end reasoning-centric large language model designed for open-domain rare disease diagnosis directly from unstructured clinical notes. We design a progressive end-to-end training framework by synergizing knowledge internalization with autonomous evolutionary learning, thereby bypassing reliance on structured phenotypes and closed-set decision-making. To overcome the limitations of RAG and phenotype restriction, we enabled the deep internalization of fragmented rare-disease knowledge directly into the model's parameters. Moreover, to bridge the gap between model generation and expert reasoning, we propose Reflection-Enhanced Reasoning Sampling (RERS), a strategy that synthesizes expert-level diagnostic trajectories by learning from failures without human annotation. Additionally, we propose a dual-level curriculum reinforcement learning approach for gradually mastering rare disease diagnosis. Experimental results demonstrate that RareDxR1 achieves state-of-the-art accuracy across different benchmarks, marking a significant breakthrough in open-domain rare disease diagnosis. Our code and dataset will be publicly available.
2607.00147.paper_summary_zh: 罕見疾病的鑑別診斷是一項關鍵但艱鉅的臨床任務，要求醫生從複雜且非結構化的病人症狀中識別出精確的表型，並在廣泛的搜索空間內執行複雜的推理。<lb/>然而，現有的人工智慧方法通常依賴於基於管道的表型提取或增強檢索生成，這些方法因預定義的本體、檢索瓶頸以及缺乏診斷邏輯而遭遇關鍵信息損失。<lb/>為了解決這些挑戰，我們推出了RareDxR1，一個以推理為中心的端到端大型語言模型，旨在直接從非結構化臨床筆記中進行開放域的罕見疾病診斷。<lb/>我們設計了一個漸進的端到端訓練框架，通過協同知識內化與自主進化學習，從而避免依賴結構化表型和封閉集決策。<lb/>為了克服RAG和表型限制的局限性，我們使得碎片化的罕見疾病知識能夠深入內化到模型的參數中。<lb/>此外，為了彌合模型生成與專家推理之間的差距，我們提出了反思增強推理取樣（RERS），這是一種通過從失敗中學習而無需人類標註來合成專家級診斷軌跡的策略。<lb/>此外，我們提出了一種雙層課程強化學習方法，以逐步掌握罕見疾病診斷。<lb/>實驗結果表明，RareDxR1在不同基準測試中達到了最先進的準確性，標誌著開放域罕見疾病診斷的一個重大突破。<lb/>我們的代碼和數據集將公開提供。
